name: Files Capture
description: Capture and summarise files that arrive with no stated context.

agents.name: Files Manager
agents.primary_routing_snippet:
- **`files-manager`** -- owns file understanding across the vault: the
  catch-all for an uploaded file that arrives with no stated context, AND
  summarizing/tagging files already captured under a Thread's own folder.
  **Don't open it, don't inspect it, don't try to help with it yourself
  first** -- relay the file's own local path immediately, not a description
  of it; `files-manager` does its own reading:
  `terminal(command="hermes -p files-manager chat -q \"Capture this file: <local file path>\" -Q")`.
